newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Feb 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Feb 11.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Internships to be offered to students to fight youth unemployment.
-- Past management of group Stern under legal investigation over a 1990 subsidiary bankruptcy.
-- New DVD standard disc for information storage to be launched in France in March.
-- German group Mannesmann to become majority shareholder in Vallourec steel tube manufacturer.
